content_type_routes.description: Maps each content type class name to the vendor mirrors that receive its rendered output.

content_type_delivery_caps.description: Observed hard delivery limit, in bytes, that a vendor imposes on a rendered content type. A missing entry means no known limit — never a fabricated one. Codex truncates root AGENTS.md past project_doc_max_bytes (openai/codex#7138).

content_type_temperatures.description: Per-vendor temperature for each content type. Each key is a content type class name; each value maps vendor name to temperature tier.
